sql.ahj.inspection.detailByAhj: WITH metroAreasWithStates AS ( select lov.id as "metro_area_id", s.id as "state_id", s.state from flow.list_of_value lov inner join flow.state s on s.abbreviation = substring(lov.name from 1 for 2) where lov.parent_id = 172 and lov.archived is false ) SELECT i.*, ahj.metro_area_id, maws.state_id, maws.state AS "stateName", coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(contacts))) FROM ( SELECT c.id, c.name, c.title, c.email, c.phone_number AS "phoneNumber", c.address, c.notes, c.hours, act.id AS "contactTypeId" FROM brs.ahj_contact c INNER JOIN brs.ahj_inspection_contact aic ON c.id = aic.ahj_contact_id INNER JOIN brs.ahj_contact_type act ON act.id = c.contact_type_id WHERE aic.ahj_inspection_id = i.id AND c.archived IS FALSE AND c.contact_type_id = 9) contacts ), '[]' ) AS utility_service_dept_contacts, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(contacts))) FROM ( SELECT c.id, c.name, c.title, c.email, c.phone_number AS "phoneNumber", c.address, c.notes, c.hours FROM brs.ahj_contact c INNER JOIN brs.ahj_inspection_contact aic ON c.id = aic.ahj_contact_id WHERE aic.ahj_inspection_id = i.id AND c.archived IS FALSE AND c.contact_type_id = 2) contacts ), '[]' ) AS scheduling_contacts, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(contacts))) FROM ( SELECT c.id, c.name, c.title, c.email, c.phone_number AS "phoneNumber", c.address, c.notes, c.hours FROM brs.ahj_contact c INNER JOIN brs.ahj_inspection_contact aic ON c.id = aic.ahj_contact_id WHERE aic.ahj_inspection_id = i.id AND c.archived IS FALSE AND c.contact_type_id = 3) contacts ), '[]' ) AS obtaining_results_contacts, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(contacts))) FROM ( SELECT c.id, c.name, c.title, c.email, c.phone_number AS "phoneNumber", c.address, c.notes, c.hours FROM brs.ahj_contact c INNER JOIN brs.ahj_inspection_contact aic ON c.id = aic.ahj_contact_id WHERE aic.ahj_inspection_id = i.id AND c.archived IS FALSE AND c.contact_type_id = 4) contacts ), '[]' ) AS fee_contacts, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(checklist))) FROM ( SELECT ac.id, ac.description, ac.display_order AS "displayOrder", ac.failed_inspection_date AS "failedInspectionDate", ac.failed_inspection_resource_id AS "failedInspectionResourceId", ac.failed_inspection_project AS "failedInspectionProject", o.org_name AS "resource" FROM brs.ahj_checklist ac INNER JOIN brs.ahj_inspection_checklist aic ON ac.id = aic.ahj_checklist_id INNER JOIN flow.org o ON o.id = ac.failed_inspection_resource_id WHERE ac.archived IS FALSE AND aic.ahj_inspection_id = i.id AND ac.checklist_type_id = 8 ORDER BY ac.display_order) checklist ), '[]' ) AS failureChecklist, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(checklist))) FROM ( SELECT ac.id, ac.description, ac.display_order AS "displayOrder" FROM brs.ahj_checklist ac INNER JOIN brs.ahj_inspection_checklist aic ON ac.id = aic.ahj_checklist_id WHERE ac.archived IS FALSE AND aic.ahj_inspection_id = i.id AND ac.checklist_type_id = 9 ORDER BY ac.display_order) checklist ), '[]' ) AS schedulingChecklist, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(checklist))) FROM ( SELECT ac.id, ac.description, ac.display_order AS "displayOrder" FROM brs.ahj_checklist ac INNER JOIN brs.ahj_inspection_checklist aic ON ac.id = aic.ahj_checklist_id WHERE ac.archived IS FALSE AND aic.ahj_inspection_id = i.id AND ac.checklist_type_id = 10 ORDER BY ac.display_order) checklist ), '[]' ) AS obtainingResultsChecklist, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(checklist))) FROM ( SELECT ac.id, ac.description, ac.display_order AS "displayOrder" FROM brs.ahj_checklist ac INNER JOIN brs.ahj_inspection_checklist aic ON ac.id = aic.ahj_checklist_id WHERE ac.archived IS FALSE AND aic.ahj_inspection_id = i.id AND ac.checklist_type_id = 11 ORDER BY ac.display_order) checklist ), '[]' ) AS reinspectionsChecklist, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(checklist))) FROM ( SELECT ac.id, ac.description, ac.display_order AS "displayOrder" FROM brs.ahj_checklist ac INNER JOIN brs.ahj_inspection_checklist aic ON ac.id = aic.ahj_checklist_id WHERE ac.archived IS FALSE AND aic.ahj_inspection_id = i.id AND ac.checklist_type_id = 12 ORDER BY ac.display_order) checklist ), '[]' ) AS schedulingWithAhjChecklist, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(checklist))) FROM ( SELECT ac.id, ac.description, ac.display_order AS "displayOrder" FROM brs.ahj_checklist ac INNER JOIN brs.ahj_inspection_checklist aic ON ac.id = aic.ahj_checklist_id WHERE ac.archived IS FALSE AND aic.ahj_inspection_id = i.id AND ac.checklist_type_id = 13 ORDER BY ac.display_order) checklist ), '[]' ) AS schedulingWithBrsTechnicianChecklist, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(requirements))) FROM ( WITH open_challenge AS ( SELECT ahj_id, original_requirement_id, status_id FROM brs.ahj_requirements ar WHERE status_id = 3 AND ar.archived IS NOT TRUE ) SELECT ar.ahj_id AS "ahjId", ar.position, ar.status_id AS "statusId", ars.name status, ar.complete, ar.date_created AS "dateCreated", ar.created_by_id AS "createdById", concat(u.first_name,' ',u.last_name) AS "createdBy", ar.date_modified AS "dateModified", ar.modified_by_id AS "modifiedById", ar.archived, concat(u2.first_name,' ',u2.last_name) AS "modifiedBy", r.id, r.description, r.requirement_type_id AS "requirementTypeId", ar.original_requirement_id AS "originalRequirementId", art.name AS "requirementType", CASE WHEN oc.original_requirement_id IS NOT NULL THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS "hasOpenChallenge" FROM brs.ahj_requirements ar LEFT JOIN open_challenge oc ON oc.ahj_id = ar.ahj_id AND oc.original_requirement_id = ar.original_requirement_id INNER JOIN brs.ahj_requirement r ON r.id = ar.requirement_id INNER JOIN brs.ahj_requirement_type art ON art.id = r.requirement_type_id INNER JOIN flow."user" u ON u.id = ar.created_by_id INNER JOIN flow."user" u2 ON u2.id = ar.modified_by_id INNER JOIN brs.ahj_requirement_status ars ON ars.id = ar.status_id WHERE ar.ahj_id = i.ahj_id AND art.id = 5 AND ar.status_id = 1 AND ar.archived IS NOT TRUE AND ars.archived IS NOT TRUE and art.archived IS NOT TRUE ORDER BY ar.position) requirements ), '[]' ) AS installationRequirements, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(links))) FROM ( SELECT apl.id, apl.name, apl.link, apl.username, apl.link_type_id AS "linkTypeId", apl.password, apl.notes FROM brs.ahj_inspection_link apl WHERE apl.archived IS FALSE AND apl.link_type_id = 1 AND apl.ahj_inspection_id = i.id) links ), '[]' ) AS schedulingLinks, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(links))) FROM ( SELECT apl.id, apl.name, apl.link, apl.username, apl.link_type_id AS "linkTypeId", apl.password, apl.notes FROM brs.ahj_inspection_link apl WHERE apl.archived IS FALSE AND apl.link_type_id = 2 AND apl.ahj_inspection_id = i.id) links ), '[]' ) AS fotLinks, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(links))) FROM ( SELECT apl.id, apl.name, apl.link, apl.username, apl.link_type_id AS "linkTypeId", apl.password, apl.notes FROM brs.ahj_inspection_link apl WHERE apl.archived IS FALSE AND apl.link_type_id = 3 AND apl.ahj_inspection_id = i.id) links ), '[]' ) AS resultsLinks, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(fots))) FROM ( SELECT upv.user_id AS "id", upv.first_name AS "firstName", upv.last_name AS "lastName", concat(upv.first_name,' ',upv.last_name) AS "fullName", (select array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(fots))) from (select o.id AS "orgId", upv.org_level_id AS "orgLevelId", o.org_name AS "orgName", upv.position_level AS "positionLevel" from flow.org o where o.id = upv.org_id) fots ) AS "hierarchy" FROM flow.user_positions_vw upv INNER JOIN flow.org o ON o.id = upv.org_id LEFT JOIN flow.organization_custom_field_value ocfv ON ocfv.org_id = o.id LEFT JOIN brs.ahj ON ahj.metro_area_id = ocfv.int_value WHERE upv.end_date IS NULL AND upv.user_archived IS FALSE and upv.archived is not true AND upv.primary_flag IS TRUE AND o.org_type_id = 8 AND ahj.id = i.ahj_id) fots ), '[]' ) AS servicingFots, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(noteTemplates))) FROM ( SELECT n.id, n.title, n.note FROM brs.ahj_base_note_template n INNER JOIN brs.ahj_inspection_base_note bn ON n.id = bn.ahj_base_note_template_id WHERE bn.ahj_inspection_id = i.id AND n.archived IS FALSE) AS noteTemplates ), '[]' ) AS noteTemplates FROM brs.ahj_inspection i INNER JOIN brs.ahj ahj ON ahj.id = i.ahj_id LEFT JOIN metroAreasWithStates maws ON maws.metro_area_id = ahj.metro_area_id WHERE i.ahj_id = :ahjId
sql.ahj.inspection.findById: WITH metroAreasWithStates AS ( select lov.id as "metro_area_id", s.id as "state_id", s.state from flow.list_of_value lov inner join flow.state s on s.abbreviation = substring(lov.name from 1 for 2) where lov.parent_id = 172 and lov.archived is false ) SELECT i.*, ahj.metro_area_id, maws.state_id, maws.state AS "stateName" FROM brs.ahj_inspection i INNER JOIN brs.ahj ahj ON ahj.id = i.ahj_id LEFT JOIN metroAreasWithStates maws ON maws.metro_area_id = ahj.metro_area_id WHERE i.id = :id
sql.ahj.inspection.createBlank: INSERT INTO brs.ahj_inspection (ahj_id, inspection_fee, re_inspection_fee, payment_method, inspection_time_window, brs_inspection_rep, portal_url, portal_username, portal_password, obtaining_results_method, approval_document_method, obtaining_results_portal_url, obtaining_results_portal_username, obtaining_results_portal_password, business_license, contractor_license, archived, date_created, created_by_id, date_modified, modified_by_id, ladder_required, time_window, time_window_call_time, time_window_phone) VALUES (:ahjId, null, null, null, null, null, null, null, null, null, null, null, null, null, null, null, false, now(), :currentUser, null, null, null, null, null, null) RETURNING id
sql.ahj.inspection.create: INSERT INTO brs.ahj_inspection (ahj_id, date_created, created_by_id) VALUES (:ahjId, now(), :currentUser)
sql.ahj.inspection.update:

scheduling_note = :schedulingNote, technician_instruction_note = :technicianInstructionNote, scheduling_with_customer_note = :schedulingWithCustomerNote, obtaining_results_note = :obtainingResultsNote, reinspection_note = :reinspectionNote, documentation_note = :documentationNote, mpu_inspection_note = :mpuInspectionNote,
inspection_time_window = :inspectionTimeWindow, brs_inspection_rep = :brsInspectionRep, portal_url = :portalUrl, portal_username = :portalUsername, portal_password = :portalPassword, obtaining_results_method = :obtainingResultsMethod, approval_document_method = :approvalDocumentMethod, obtaining_results_portal_url = :obtainingResultsPortalUrl, obtaining_results_portal_username = :obtainingResultsPortalUsername, obtaining_results_portal_password = :obtainingResultsPortalPassword, business_license = :businessLicense, contractor_license = :contractorLicense, ladder_required = :ladderRequired, time_window = :timeWindow, time_window_call_time = :timeWindowCallTime, time_window_phone = :timeWindowPhone, date_modified = now(), modified_by_id = :currentUser WHERE id = :id

sql.ahj.inspection.searchAhjsByState: WITH metroAreasWithStates AS ( select lov.id as "metro_area_id", s.id as "state_id" from flow.list_of_value lov inner join flow.state s on s.abbreviation = substring(lov.name from 1 for 2) where lov.parent_id = 172 and lov.archived is false ) SELECT i.id, i.ahj_id FROM brs.ahj_inspection i INNER JOIN brs.ahj ahj ON ahj.id = i.ahj_id INNER JOIN flow.list_of_value lov ON lov.id = ahj.metro_area_id LEFT JOIN metroAreasWithStates maws ON maws.metro_area_id = ahj.metro_area_id WHERE maws.state_id = :stateId AND ahj.archived IS FALSE
sql.ahj.inspection.link.create: INSERT INTO brs.ahj_inspection_link (ahj_inspection_id, name, link, username, password, notes, date_created, created_by_id, link_type_id) VALUES (:ahjInspectionId, :name, :link, :username, :password, :notes, now(), :currentUser, :linkTypeId)
sql.ahj.inspection.link.update: UPDATE brs.ahj_inspection_link SET ahj_inspection_id = :ahjInspectionId, name = :name, link = :link, username = :username, password = :password, notes = :notes, date_modified = now(), modified_by_id = :currentUser WHERE id = :id
sql.ahj.inspection.link.delete: UPDATE brs.ahj_inspection_link SET archived = TRUE, date_modified = now(), modified_by_id = :currentUser WHERE id = :id
sql.ahj.inspection.note.template.update: UPDATE brs.ahj_base_note_template SET title = :title, note = :note WHERE id = :id
sql.ahj.inspection.note.template.delete: UPDATE brs.ahj_base_note_template SET archived = TRUE WHERE id = :id
